ai_resume_analyzer.name: AI Resume Analyzer & Matcher
ai_resume_analyzer.purpose: Built to explore a practical recruitment use case using AI: extracting structured information from resumes and job descriptions and comparing candidates against job requirements.
features: Extracts structured candidate information from resumes
Extracts information from job descriptions
Supports PDF and DOCX resumes
Uses Groq LLM calls for information extraction
Uses Pydantic models for schema validation
Uses structured JSON outputs
Can process multiple candidates
Ranks candidates using deterministic Python scoring
Considers skills, evidence, experience, education and resume quality
challenges: Making LLM-generated information structured and reliable enough to process programmatically
Designing candidate scoring so that ranking is based on actual evidence rather than blindly trusting an LLM-generated score
Handling resume information coming from different document formats and structures
learnings: Integrating LLM APIs into Python applications
Using structured LLM outputs instead of only free-form text
Extracting text from PDF and DOCX documents
Using environment variables for API keys
Separating AI-based extraction from deterministic Python logic
Understanding that LLM output should be validated rather than automatically trusted
possible_improvements: Test with a larger variety of resumes and job descriptions
Provide clearer explanations for candidate scores
Make the overall system more robust

ai_portfolio_chatbot.name: AI Portfolio Chatbot
ai_portfolio_chatbot.purpose: An interactive AI portfolio assistant that allows recruiters and other visitors to ask questions about Mayank's education, skills, projects, strengths, weaknesses, interests and technical background.
features: Extracts structured information from Mayank's resume
Loads additional candidate information from a JSON profile
Provides a recruiter-facing conversational interface
Answers questions using Mayank's supplied candidate information
Streams AI responses from the FastAPI backend to the frontend
Maintains conversation history for multi-turn conversations
Uses separate session IDs so different visitors can maintain independent conversations
Allows users to clear the current conversation and start a new chat
Renders structured AI responses using Markdown
Uses system instructions designed to reduce unsupported claims and hallucinations
Distinguishes between technologies Mayank has actually used, technologies he is learning and fields he is interested in
Uses a responsive React and TypeScript frontend
Includes an interactive WebGL-based visual interface

architecture.candidate_data: Structured resume information and additional candidate information stored in JSON
architecture.communication: HTTP API with streamed text responses

challenges: Preventing the chatbot from inventing candidate information that is not present in the supplied data
Distinguishing Mayank's interests and current learning from technologies he has actually used
Maintaining conversation history while keeping different visitor sessions separate
Streaming LLM responses from the FastAPI backend to the React frontend
Building an interactive portfolio interface around the conversational AI system
learnings: Building a FastAPI backend for an AI application
Connecting a React and TypeScript frontend to a Python backend
Integrating Groq LLM calls into a web application
Streaming LLM responses from the backend to the frontend
Managing conversation history and session IDs
Using structured candidate data to ground AI responses
Using prompt engineering to constrain LLM responses
Using Pydantic to structure and validate candidate information
Using different AI tools like Chat GPt , Claude,Anti-Gravity, Groq LLM for different tasks
Building a responsive conversational portfolio interface,using AI agenets.
ai_portfolio_chatbot.honesty_rule: The chatbot answers using the supplied candidate information and should not invent unsupported skills, achievements or experience.

limitations: Does not claim professional software engineering experience
Does not claim to be an AI/ML expert
Does not claim advanced competitive programming ability
Is still developing software development experience
